$comment: Figma↔code mapping for published component sets. The counterpart of design/tokens.json, which does the same job for variables. Component sets are named for how they read on canvas, not mechanically, so this file is what makes non-obvious pairings (Buttons → Button.astro, curiosity → CuriosityRow.astro) safe to rely on. Each component file also opens with a comment naming its set and node id, so the mapping is discoverable from either end.

sets.notes: The matrix is sparse in Figma and sparse in code — only the six combinations above exist. State is a CSS :hover, not a prop. Renders <a> when href is present, <button type="button"> otherwise. Icon=ON (`377:2215`) exists on Type=Primary only: 16 / 12 padding around a 28 icon (60 × 52), no label drawn — the component keeps the default slot as the accessible name and hides it visually. Hover draws 64 × 56 by growing the icon to 32; code scales the icon by 32/28 instead of growing the box, the same no-reflow rule .btn__ghost follows for text.

Named ChatBubble because the set draws one bubble, not the thread. Figma gives request/text and request/selection a single style branch, so the component does too. The :hover on request is not in the design — it is pre-existing behaviour carried over from src/pages/index.astro. --size-chat-choice (400px) is unbound in Figma.

Named Avatar because `user` collides with the prop it takes. The Figma user set has no max variant; Avatar adds the three max grounds from the logo set: neutral (`108:1371`, neutral-white/tomato-500), tomato (`108:1370`, tomato-100/tomato-500), and herbs (`108:1369`, herbs-100/herbs-500). Tomato is the code default, preserving the previous rendering. `all` resolves to /avatars/everyone.svg — the asset predates the Figma variant name.

The three separate artworks are not one recolourable SVG: both the circular ground and the base rectangle recolour. Avatar owns the neutral, tomato and herbs max grounds; public/favicon.svg is the neutral variant. Logo.astro was deleted because the favicon needs no component.

Rebuilt by Max on 10 Sep 2026 as the single source for every mark, and the scope boundary recorded here before it is now REVERSED: the eight footer marks ARE this set. Twenty symbols on a two-axis matrix — Icon × Color — with Black (#040302) and White (#FDFCF8) pairs for the eight marks, and single Lemon (Cursor, `109:1373`, 40×40) and Black (Figma Make, `140:1095`, 56×56; download `377:2133` and share `377:2143`, 28×28) entries. Marks are 16 tall at their own drawn widths: perplexity `387:2931`/`389:2932` 16, anthropic `387:2929`/`389:2934` 16, openai `387:2930`/`389:2936` 16.14, figma `389:2969`/`389:2974` 11.53, github `389:2970`/`389:2981` 16.44, dribbble `389:2971`/`389:2992` 16, behance `389:2972`/`389:2987` 19, linkedin `389:2973`/`389:2997` 16.15. Geometry verified identical to the shipped assets, which resolves two open items: the third "explore with" mark is PERPLEXITY, not unidentified, and public/icons/dark/ is the set's own White variant rather than a code invention. Two deltas remain: the shipped light marks carry #171613 because that is what the NavBar Mode=Default instance paints them, while the set's Color=Black is #040302 — an instance paint, not drift; and the files are still named explore-3.svg, explore-claude.svg and explore-openai.svg rather than perplexity, anthropic and openai. Separately, public/cursor-pointer.svg (16×16) has NO Figma node: it is the same circle re-drawn at pointer size for the site-wide CSS cursor, because a url() cursor renders at the asset's intrinsic size and CSS cannot scale it. The 40×40 mark is what /styleguide renders. Change the colour and both files need it.

Each variant is its own geometry, so PostIt carries four sets of custom properties rather than one shared offset. The paper is 181 × 181 with 40 / 16 / 16 padding, Elevation / md and its own clip; the 500-step disc is 40 × 40 and sits at (104, 0) herbs, (41, 0) tomato, (32, 18.5) lemon, (43, 11) pickled inside boxes of 197 × 211, 192 × 211, 188 × 222 and 200 × 227. Figma rotations herbs +5, tomato −3, lemon +2 and pickled −6 become CSS rotate(-5deg), rotate(3deg), rotate(-2deg) and rotate(6deg) because Figma is counter-clockwise-positive while CSS is clockwise-positive.

The drawn states became a `state` prop, and client JS toggles Front/Back instantly because Figma defines no motion for that swap. Max's prose defines a separate small-card hover/focus magnification, not a Figma prototype: State=small is 0.435 × Front, so the focused card scales by 2.2989 and its immediately adjacent small siblings by the geometric midpoint 1.5162. With JS blocked the prop is what renders and the buttons are inert.

Named CuriosityRow because the set is one row, not the section. It is an Avatar beside a ChatBubble type="message" and nothing more, so the component composes those two rather than restyling either. Maps to the curiosity collection (thought + question).

The frame's copy (`Let’s be honest`) is final in Max's voice, not placeholder, so it is the prop default. BlankSection is the set's named instance of the general heading-plus-body layout in TextSection.astro. TextSection has no Figma set and therefore no separate sets entry. Body arrives through the default slot because the source is markdown in collection frontmatter.

Renders one position. Mirrors the resume collection in src/content.config.ts. The date range is formatted by src/lib/dates.ts formatRange; the hyphen-minus in "Mar - Oct 2026" is the design's glyph, not an en dash. Text styles as re-read on 2026-09-10: Date is Mono - Small in neutral-600, Role is Body - Large at regular, Company is Body - Large at bold, Description is Body in neutral-800 — role and company are the reverse of the weights src/components/feedback.md asked for a week earlier. The logo column (`377:1946`) is 40 wide with 8 of top padding.

exploded/small does not exist. Props are presentation-level rather than schema-level because the page decides which projects fields feed them. The decorative paper-scrap collage is absolutely-positioned aria-hidden geometry with no token — its per-scrap offsets, sizes and rotations are not yet transcribed, so the collage does not render yet.

Six columns of tiles, as drawn. No content collection exists for tools, so /styleguide passes placeholders. An entry with no icon renders the empty tile the design already draws, with its name as the visible label.
The tomato dot is a ::before disc, not a ::marker — ::marker colour is not reliably settable. No content collection exists, so /styleguide passes placeholders.

Renders ONE note, not the feed. The design's third section label is `tools`, which is why the prop is; the releaseNotes schema field is `tech`, so the `tools:` key in src/content/release-notes/2026-08-17.md frontmatter is silently dropped by Zod today. That is a content-field rename, out of scope here. The inactive greys are token-chosen, not transcribed.

Renders ONE case-study section, not the whole study. Mirrors caseSection in src/content.config.ts. The frame's prose is lorem ipsum, so /styleguide passes bracketed copy. The frame binds a stray variable `Sizes/L: 24` that sits outside the seven real collections and is already marked for deletion; it has no CSS token, and --space-md is 24px. The inactive greys are token-chosen, not transcribed. The styleguide now passes four bracketed placeholder artefacts from src/assets/styleguide/.

Named NavBar in Figma but reads as the site footer: legal link, an "explore with" credit, seven section links and five social marks. Claude and ChatGPT are accessible links with placeholder hrefs; the unidentified third mark remains decorative. Layout as drawn (`114:189`): #impressum and the explore credit at the two ends of the left column; the four section links, then the about links over the social marks, on the right. Socials carry their drawn intrinsic sizes: Figma 12×16, GitHub 17×16, Dribbble 16×16, Behance 19×16, LinkedIn 17×16. Mode is a ground colour per instance, NOT a colour scheme: Mode=Dark paints every mark neutral-white, so public/icons/dark/ holds the same eight artworks with that fill and src/config/site.ts carries both paths. The bar is full-bleed at every viewport — it has no max-width. The label prop keeps the two /styleguide landmarks unique. Below 48rem the row stacks; Figma's Mobile frame (`103:1103`) is empty, so that decision is undesigned.

unbound.$comment: Values the design uses that no Figma variable holds. Each is a literal in code with a comment saying so. Listed here so the next sync can see them without re-reading the file.
items: --size-chat-choice (400px) — the max-width on four of the five Chat combinations.
ChatBubble's 2px stroke (`109:1385`, `109:1386`, `109:1388`) — no --border-width-* token tier exists.
The 1px frame borders in ProjectSection and ReleaseNote — not Figma-read, still chosen, and no --border-width-* token tier exists.
The 48rem breakpoint in NavBar, ToolBox and global.css — CSS custom properties cannot be used in media-query conditions.
focus areas item gap 13px (`114:311`) — no spacing token holds it.
tool box tile 57 × 59.33 (`114:272`) — transcribed as aspect-ratio: 57 / 59.33.

The #ffffff fill on the slot placeholders — tool box tile (`114:272`), CV section Logo (`114:255`) and its three Image slots. One step off neutral-white and unbound; code paints them neutral-white, which is invisible against the page ground, as it is in Figma.

The explore-with marks' drop-shadow(0 1px 2px …) in NavBar — not an Elevation style. Verified against `114:196` (Mode=Default) and `385:2254`/`385:2256`/`385:2262` (Mode=Dark): 25% lemon-500 in Mode=Default, 75% in Mode=Dark. CSS-owned via color-mix, no longer duplicated inside the exported SVGs.
w-[383.108px] on the NavBar impressum column — a magic number, dropped in code.
The project preview paper-scrap collage geometry.
Sizes/L: 24 in project sections — a stray variable outside the seven collections, already marked for deletion.
The post-it geometry — the 181 paper, the 40 disc, and the four per-variant boxes and offsets (`114:577`-`114:580`).
The post-it copy's #000000 fill (`114:174`) — the only unbound text fill in the set; code keeps neutral-800 rather than introduce a second near-black.
The share icon's two #000000 strokes beside its #040302 discs (`377:2143`) — exported verbatim.
The .btn--icon 28 / 32 icon box (`377:2215`, `377:2217`) — an icon size, not a spacing step.
The /resume note rail's count rule — two notes every five combined rows, plus one. Handoff §13 names a 300-400px gap, not a count, and no drawn value fixes either.

The page grid — 10 columns, 24 gutter, 96 margin on the 1280 frames; 5/16/24 on the 375 Mobile frames. A layout grid is not a variable, so --grid-frame/--grid-margin/--grid-columns/--grid-gutter/--grid-column live only in src/styles/tokens.css.

outstanding.$comment: The Figma MCP server is reachable again. The blocked reads and asset exports are complete; public/favicon.svg differed and Figma's neutral-white ground won. `variableWrites` is now unblocked and is the only Figma mutation still outstanding. `geometryReads` and `unverifiedChoices` are deliberately deferred code-sync work, not authentication blockers.
variableWrites: Typography collection is missing font/weight/bold = 700, line-height/none = 1 and line-height/relaxed = 1.4. All three already exist in src/styles/tokens.css and design/tokens.json, so the three-file rule is two-thirds done. Each needs a value, a description, scopes, and WEB code syntax (var(--font-weight-bold), var(--line-height-none), var(--line-height-relaxed)) — without the code syntax the MCP emits var(--line-height\/none), which is not valid CSS. The collection has one mode, named Value.

Re-bind the text styles that still hold raw numbers: Typography/H1–H5 → line-height/none; Typography/Body - Small and Typography/Captions → line-height/relaxed. Until then get_variable_defs reports floats instead of names.

Delete size/chat-column (866) and size/chat-bubble (531) from the Size collection. Both are now computed from the page grid in CSS — 8 and 5 columns — so the variables have no code counterpart. size/chat-choice (400) stays: it is not a column span.
geometryReads: project preview (114:646) — the decorative paper-scrap collage: per-scrap offsets, sizes and rotations, plus what the exploded state moves. The component currently renders no scraps, so `exploded` has no visual expression and is observable only through data-state and aria-pressed.
unverifiedChoices: Spacing gaps still awaiting a Figma read: ToolBox tile gaps, CuriosityRow's avatar gap, BlankSection/TextSection's body gap, and CvSection's project-row gap.

The inactive greys in ReleaseNote and ProjectSection. Picked as --color-neutral-700 for text (7.91:1 on neutral-100) and --color-neutral-600 for frames (3.40:1, clearing the 3:1 non-text bar) rather than by eye.
NavBar mode=default ground = --color-neutral-100. Only the dark ground was transcribed.
NavBar's columns stack below 48rem, and the row itself no longer wraps — the drawn 1280 frame is now full-bleed at every width, so the wrap that stopped #aboutme being clipped is unnecessary.
CvSection's role label drops white-space: nowrap below 48rem, for the reason the NavBar row wrapped: a long role ran off the right edge instead of reflowing.
/resume stacks its note rail under the timeline below 48rem. The Mobile frame (`103:1124`) is unfinished, so where the notes go on a phone is undrawn.
ToolBox drops 6 columns to 2 below 48rem. A second undesigned mobile decision beyond the NavBar one.

ProjectSection's artefact strip auto-scrolls: endless 40 px/s drift, latched off by pointer, wheel, touch, key or focus, temporarily paused on hover. Requested directly; no prototype connection exists in project sections (115:755), so nothing about the timing is Figma-read.
